z-m-15-05.title: Graph ipi yakanaka kuratidza data imwe chete?
z-m-15-05.goal: Enzanisa kuti rudzi rwega rwega rwe graph runoratidza sei zvimwe zvakanaka uye zvimwe zvisina kunaka, uye usarudze graph inokodzera chinangwa, uchipa zvikonzero.
z-m-15-05.material:
Library yechikoro yakaongorora huwandu hwemabhuku akatorwa mwedzi wega wega kubva Kurume kusvika Nyamavhuvhu.
Kurume 350, Kubvumbi 380, Chivabvu 420, Chikumi 300, Chikunguru 410, Nyamavhuvhu 560 (total yemwedzi 6 ndi2420)
Tinoda kuratidza data iyi mu graph. Mu pie chart, hatinyori huwandu hwemabhuku kana total, asi saizi yema sectors nemazita emwedzi chete, uye ma sectors akaiswa nenhevedzano kubva pahombe.
z-m-15-05.thinking.0: Kuenzanisa nekuongorora nzira dzekuratidza data kuti dzikodzere chinangwa
z-m-15-05.thinking.2: Kubvuma kuti zvisarudzo zvakawanda zvinogona kuva zvakarurama
z-m-15-05.prereq.0: Unogona kuverenga line graphs ne bar graphs (nhanho yegrade 4)
z-m-15-05.prereq.1: Unoziva kuti circle graph kana band graph inoratidza ratio yezvikamu kuchose (nhanho yegrade 6)
z-m-15-05.s.s1.prompt: Unoda kuratidza pakarepo kuti huwandu hwemabhuku akatorwa kubva Kurume kusvika Nyamavhuvhu hwakachinja sei (kuyerera kwekukwira nekudzikira). Graph ipi inokodzera zvakanyanya?
z-m-15-05.s.s1.hint.0: Taura mumutsara mumwe kana zvaunoda kuratidza ndezve 'zvakawanda mwedzi wega wega' kana 'zvakachinja sei sezvo mwedzi ichipfuura.'
z-m-15-05.s.s1.hint.1: Fungidzira graph imwe neimwe mupfungwa dzako uye uenzanise kana shanduko kubva Chivabvu kuenda Chikumi inoonekwa.
z-m-15-05.s.s1.r.a: Graph iyi inoratidza chikamu chemwedzi wega wega chechose. Haikodzeri kuratidza kuyerera kwekukwira nekudzikira sezvo mwedzi ichipfuura.
z-m-15-05.s.s1.r.b: Yakanaka kuenzanisa saizi mwedzi nemwedzi. Kuratidza kuyerera, line graph inogona kukodzera zvirinani.
z-m-15-05.s.s1.r.c: Graph iyi inoparadzanisa chose kuita strip imwe kuratidza zvikamu. Zvakaoma kuratidza nzira yeshanduko mumwedzi.
z-m-15-05.s.s1.r.d: Wakarangarira kuti igraph inoratidza huwandu hunochinja nenguva nekukwira nekudzikira kwemutsara.
z-m-15-05.s.s1.explain: Kuratidza kuti makosha anochinja sei sezvo nguva ichipfuura, line graph ndiyo yakananga zvikuru. Bar graph inogona kuenzanisawo mwedzi nemwedzi, asi line graph inoratidza zvakajeka mutsara uchikwira nekudzikira sezvaunobatanidza.
z-m-15-05.s.s1.acc.0: Bar graph iri nyorewo kuenzanisa mwedzi nemwedzi, uye kukwira nekudzikira kunogona kuverengwa kubva pakukwirira kwemabhawa. Zvisinei, nzira nesaizi yeshanduko zvinoonekwa zvakajeka pakutarisa chete mu slope yemutsara pa line graph.
z-m-15-05.s.s2.prompt: Kana yadhirowwa se pie chart (pasina huwandu hwemabhuku kana total, saizi dzema sectors nemazita emwedzi chete, nema sectors akaiswa kubva pahombe), sarudza zvose zvaunogona kuziva pakarepo kubva pagraph oga.
z-m-15-05.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga warongedza kana circle graph inoratidza 'huwandu hwemabhuku' kana 'chikamu chechose.'
z-m-15-05.s.s2.hint.1: Rongedza sarudzo imwe neimwe kuita mibvunzo inogona kupindurwa nechikamu kana inoda kurongeka kana huwandu hweshanduko.
z-m-15-05.s.s2.o.a: Anenge percent ingani yemwedzi yose 6 yaiva kutorwa kweNyamavhuvhu
z-m-15-05.s.s2.r.a: Kuverenga chikamu chinotorwa nesector pachose ihunhu hwe circle graph.
z-m-15-05.s.s2.o.b: Mabhuku mangani akadzikira kutorwa pakati peChivabvu neChikumi
z-m-15-05.s.s2.r.b: Ma sectors anoratidza chikamu chete, uye hapana huwandu hwemabhuku kana total hwakanyorwa. Haugoni kuziva kubva pagraph oga kuti akadzikira nemabhuku mangani.
z-m-15-05.s.s2.o.c: Mwedzi une kutorwa kwakawanda zvikuru pakati pemwedzi 6
z-m-15-05.s.s2.r.c: Unogona kuwana izvi nekutsvaga sector hombe zvikuru.
z-m-15-05.s.s2.r.d: Ma sectors akaiswa kubva pahombe, saka haugoni kuziva kurongeka kwemwedzi. Kana usingazivi kurongeka, zvakaoma kuziva kuyerera kwekukwira nekudzikira.
z-m-15-05.s.s2.explain: Mu pie chart, unogona kuziva zvikamu nechinhu chikuru zvikuru kubva pasaizi dzema sectors. Nyamavhuvhu ndi560÷2420, inenge 23%. Asi sezvo huwandu hwemabhuku husina kunyorwa uye kurongeka kwemwedzi hakugoni kuzikanwa, zvakaoma kuziva kubva pa pie chart oga kuti akadzikira nemabhuku mangani kana kuti akakwira nenguva.
z-m-15-05.s.s3.prompt: Shamwari yakadhirowa circle graph inoti, 'Kungotarisa graph iyi, unogona kuona zvakakwana kuyerera kwekutorwa kuchikwira.' Nyora maonero ako kushamwari yako, kusanganisira zvose zvinoratidzwa zvakanaka ne circle graph nezvinoratidzwa zvisina kunaka.
z-m-15-05.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora chinhu chimwe chaunogona kuverenga kubva pasaizi dzema sectors pa circle graph.
z-m-15-05.s.s3.hint.1: Wozonyora chinhu chimwe chaunogona kuverenga kubva pa line graph ye data imwe chete asi chakaoma kuverenga kubva pa circle graph.
z-m-15-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora zvose zvinogona kuzikanwa nezvakaoma kuzivikanwa kubva pa circle graph here?
z-m-15-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Pane muenzaniso (senge chikamu cheNyamavhuvhu) unotsigira maonero ako here?
z-m-15-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakazvibatanidza here nemamiriro anoda line graph kana imwe graph?
z-m-15-05.s.s3.model.0: Circle graph inoratidza zvakanaka percentage inotorwa nemwedzi wega wega pachose. Semuenzaniso, Nyamavhuvhu ndiro sector hombe zvikuru. Asi zvakaoma kuona kuyerera kwekukwira nekudzikira sezvo mwedzi ichipfuura, saka kuratidza kuyerera, line graph ndiyo iri nani.
z-m-15-05.s.s3.model.1: Kubva pa circle graph unogona kuziva kuti Nyamavhuvhu ndiyo hombe zvikuru, panenge 23% yechose. Asi shanduko yekudzikira muChikumi uye kukwira zvakare muChikunguru yakaoma kuwana nekuti hapana kurongeka kana huwandu hwemabhuku.
z-m-15-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: Zvaizova zvakanakazve kuwedzera mazano ekuti zvinhu zvinogona kuchinja kana huwandu hwemabhuku hwakanyorwawo.

z-m-15-04.title: Bhegi rine marbles matsvuku akawanda ndiro rakanaka here?
z-m-15-04.topic: Kuenzanisa mikana (nyaya mbiri dzine ma totals akasiyana)
z-m-15-04.goal: Sarudza ruzivo rwunodiwa kuenzanisa mikana, chinja kuenzanisa kana ruzivo rutsva rwabuda, uye ugadzire muenzaniso unoratidza kuti 'zvakawanda' ne 'zvinogoneka zvakanyanya' hazvifanani.
z-m-15-04.material: Pane bhegi 가 nebhegi 나. Unovhara maziso uye unotora marble imwe kubva mubhegi rimwe nerimwe. Ma marbles anosiyana neruvara chete; saizi nechimiro chawo zvakafanana. Mutambo umo unokunda kana ukatora marble tsvuku. Unotora marble kamwe chete, uye hauidzorerazve.
z-m-15-04.prereq.0: Kutaura saizi yechikamu chechose se fraction
z-m-15-04.prereq.1: Kuenzanisa ma fractions ane ma denominators akasiyana (nhanho yegrades 5-6)
z-m-15-04.s.s1.prompt: Zvatinoziva parizvino ndezvekuti 'bhegi 가 rine marbles matsvuku 3 uye bhegi 나 rine marbles matsvuku 5.' Chii chakakodzera zvakanyanya kutaura nezve bhegi ripi rinopa mukana wakakwirira wekukunda?

z-m-15-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ipa muenzaniso mumwe wekuti mukana unochinja sei kana huwandu hwema marbles eimwe mavara huchichinja, kunyange nehuwandu hwakafanana hwematsvuku.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.o.a: Bhegi 나 riri pamusoro. Rine marbles matsvuku 2 akawanda.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.r.a: Wakaenzanisa huwandu hwema marbles matsvuku chete. Hatisati taziva kuti chikamu chipi chema marbles ose chakatsvuka.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.o.b: Bhegi 가 riri pamusoro. Kana bhegi rine marbles mashoma, zviri nyore kuwana tsvuku.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.r.b: Wakafungidzira kuti huwandu hwose hwema marbles hushoma, asi hatina ruzivo urwu parizvino. Kufungidzira kusina hwaro.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.o.c: Hatigoni kuenzanisa kunze kwekunge tichiziva huwandu hwose hwema marbles (kana huwandu hwema marbles eimwe mavara).
z-m-15-04.s.s1.r.c: Wakaratidza kuti mukana unotarwa nekutarisa huwandu hwema marbles matsvuku nehuwandu hwose hwema marbles pamwe chete.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.o.d: Tsvuku inobuda kana kusabuda, saka mikana miviri yakafanana.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.r.d: Wakatonga kuti mikana yakafanana nekuti pane mhedzisiro mbiri. Huwandu hwemhedzisiro kufanana hakuiti kuti mikana ifanane.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.explain: Mukana unotarwa nechikamu chinotorwa nema marbles matsvuku pakati pema marbles ose. Tichiziva huwandu hwema marbles matsvuku chete, hatizivi huwandu hwose hwema marbles, saka hatigoni kutaura kuti ndeupi uri pamusoro. Munyaya yakadai, zvakakodzera kutanga taura 'kuti chii chimwe chatinofanira kuziva.'
z-m-15-04.s.s2.prompt: Pane ruzivo rutsva. Bhegi 가 rine marbles ebhuruu 2 uye bhegi 나 rine marbles ebhuruu 4, uye hapana bhegi rine marbles eimwe mavara. Zvino, mukana wekukunda uri pamusoro mubhegi ripi?

z-m-15-04.s.s2.r.a: Kutonga uku kunoenzanisa, se fractions, kuti ma marbles matsvuku ndechikamu chipi chechose mumabhegi maviri.
z-m-15-04.s.s2.o.b: Bhegi 나 riri pamusoro. Rine marbles matsvuku akawanda, 5.
z-m-15-04.s.s2.r.b: Kunyange neruzivo rutsva, wakaenzanisa huwandu hwema marbles matsvuku chete. Tarisa kana huwandu hwose hwema marbles hwachinja.
z-m-15-04.s.s2.o.c: Mabhegi maviri akafanana. Mumabhegi ose maviri pane marble 1 tsvuku yakawanda kupfuura ebhuruu.
z-m-15-04.s.s2.r.c: Wakafunga kuti kana musiyano pakati pehuwandu hwetsvuku nebhuruu wakafanana, mikana yakafanana. Kunyange nemusiyano wakafanana, ma totals anosiyana, saka zvikamu zvinogona kusiyana.
z-m-15-04.s.s2.o.d: Ma totals ema marbles akasiyana, saka hatigoni kuenzanisa kunyange mushure mekuverenga.
z-m-15-04.s.s2.r.d: Wakafunga kuti hatigoni kuenzanisa kana ma denominators akasiyana. Tinogona kuenzanisa nekuita ma denominators akafanana kana nekushandura kuita ma decimals.
z-m-15-04.s.s2.explain: Bhegi 가 rine tsvuku 3 pakati pe5 dzose, ndiyo 3/5 (0.6), uye bhegi 나 rine tsvuku 5 pakati pe9 dzose, ndiyo 5/9 (anenge 0.56). z-m-15-08.title: Kugadzira mitemo yemutambo wemakadhi une mikana yekukunda yakasiyana
z-m-15-08.goal: Tarisa kana mitemo ichiwirirana, gadzira mitemo yemutambo wako pachako inokodzera mamiriro, uye unyore mukana wekukunda wemutambi mumwe nemumwe se fraction, uchisimbisa kuti zvakagadzirwa zvakawanda zvinogoneka.
z-m-15-08.material: Pane makadhi 20, rimwe nerimwe rakanyorwa nhamba imwe kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 20. Mwaya makadhi ese, uaise akatarisa pasi, wodhonza rimwe. Kadhi rimwe nerimwe rinogona kudhonzwa zvakaenzana. A ne B vanotamba mutambo: A anokunda kana 'multiple ye m' ikabuda, uye B anokunda kana 'multiple ye n' ikabuda. (m ne n i natural numbers dzakasiyana kubva ku 2 kusvika ku 20, uye vatambi vanosarudza mitengo ye m ne n.)
z-m-15-08.thinking.2: Kunyora mikana se ma fractions uye kuienzanisa
z-m-15-08.prereq.0: Anoziva ma multiples uye anogona kutsvaga ma multiples kusvika ku 20 (padanho regiredhi re5)
z-m-15-08.prereq.1: Kuratidza chikamu chechose se fraction (padanho regiredhi re5-6)
z-m-15-08.s.s1.prompt: Kutanga, takaedza mutemo wekuti A anokunda kana multiple ye 4 ikabuda uye B anokunda kana multiple ye 6 ikabuda. Dambudziko rekutanga rekugadzirisa mumutemo uyu i ripi?
z-m-15-08.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora makadhi ese apo A anokunda nemakadhi ese apo B anokunda, uye uaise padivi pedivi.
z-m-15-08.s.s1.hint.1: Tsvaga nhamba ipi neipi iri mumarisiti ose.
z-m-15-08.s.s1.o.a: Pane ma multiples akawanda e 4 kupfuura e 6, saka B haagone kukunda chose
z-m-15-08.s.s1.r.a: Ma multiples e 6, ayo i 6, 12, ne 18, ari pakati pemakadhi, saka B anogona kukundawo. Nyora iwe pachako makadhi anogona kukundwa nemunhu mumwe nemumwe.
z-m-15-08.s.s1.o.b: Kana 12 ikabuda, A ne B vose vanokunda, saka hatigone kusarudza kuti ndiani akakunda
z-m-15-08.s.s1.r.b: Wakaratidza kuti pane kadhi rinokodzera mitemo yose miviri, saka mitemo inowirirana.
z-m-15-08.s.s1.o.c: Pane makadhi 20, saka hatigone kutamba mutambo une ma multiples
z-m-15-08.s.s1.r.c: Wakabatanidza nhamba yemakadhi nekuti mutambo unogona kutambwa here. Kunyangwe nemakadhi 20, mutemo une ma multiples unogona kushandiswa.
z-m-15-08.s.s1.o.d: Mikana yekukunda yaA neyaB inofanira kuenzana, saka tinofanira kushandisa nhamba imwechete panzvimbo pe 4 ne 6
z-m-15-08.s.s1.r.d: Kana ukashandisa nhamba imwechete, vatambi vose vanogara vachikunda pamwe chete. Kuenzana uye kusawirirana zvidambudziko zvakasiyana.
z-m-15-08.s.s1.explain: Ma multiples e 4 i makadhi 5 anoti 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, uye ma multiples e 6 i makadhi 3 anoti 6, 12, 18. 12 inoshanda kuvatambi vose, saka kana 12 ikabuda hatigone kusarudza mukundi. Tinofanira kutanga tatarisa kuti hakuna kuwirirana kwakadaro.
z-m-15-08.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mitemo 2 yakasiyana (m, n) inogutsa mamiriro ese anotevera. Mamiriro: ① Hapana kadhi rinoita kuti vatambi vose vakunde panguva imwechete. ② Mukana wekukunda waA i mukuru kupfuura mukana wekukunda waB. ③ Mukana wekukunda waB zvakare i 2 pa 20 kana kupfuura.
z-m-15-08.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora makadhi ari ma multiples e m nemakadhi ari ma multiples e n, uye utarise kuti hapana nhamba yakafanana.
z-m-15-08.s.s2.hint.1: Tanga wasarudza nhamba yemakadhi aA, wobva waedza n imwe neimwe kuti nhamba yemakadhi aB ive 2 kana kupfuura uye shoma kupfuura aA.
z-m-15-08.s.s2.ok.c1: m ne n i natural numbers dzakasiyana kubva ku 2 kusvika ku 20.
z-m-15-08.s.s2.fail.c1: m ne n dzinofanira kuva natural numbers dzakasiyana kubva ku 2 kusvika ku 20.
z-m-15-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Hapana kadhi rinoita kuti vatambi vose vakunde panguva imwechete.
z-m-15-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Pane common multiple ye m ne n mukati me 1 kusvika ku 20, saka pane kadhi rinoita kuti vatambi vose vakunde panguva imwechete.
z-m-15-08.s.s2.ok.c3: A ane makadhi akawanda anogona kukunda kupfuura B.
z-m-15-08.s.s2.ok.c4: B ane makadhi 2 kana kupfuura anogona kukunda.
z-m-15-08.s.s2.fail.c4: B ane makadhi shoma kupfuura 2 anogona kukunda.
z-m-15-08.s.s2.explain: Kuti pasave nekadhi rinowirirana, ma common multiples e m ne n anofanira kuva makuru kupfuura 20, uye unogona kuverenga nhamba yemakadhi sequotient (yakadzikiswa) ye 20÷m. Semuenzaniso, ne (3, 7), A ane makadhi 6 anoti 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18 (6 pa 20) uye B ane makadhi 2 anoti 7, 14 (2 pa 20). Mitemo yakawanda inogoneka, sa (4, 7), (5, 6), (6, 10).
z-m-15-08.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza umwe wemitemo yawangogadzira, nyora mukana wekukunda waA neuwaB wega wega se fraction, uye utsanangure kuti wakatarisa sei kuti hapana kadhi rinoita kuti vatambi vose vakunde panguva imwechete.
z-m-15-08.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora makadhi ese aA nemakadhi ese aB emutemo wawakasarudza.
z-m-15-08.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora mumutsara mumwe kuti waenzanisa sei marisiti maviri.
z-m-15-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora mikana miviri uchishandisa chose chimwechete (makadhi 20) here?
z-m-15-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti wakatarisa kuti hapana kuwirirana nenzira sema lists kana common multiples here?
z-m-15-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakatarisazve kuti mutemo wako unogutsa mamiriro ese ① ② ③ here?
z-m-15-08.s.s3.model.0: Mutemo wangu i kuti A anokunda pama multiples e 3 uye B anokunda pama multiples e 7. A ane makadhi 6 anoti 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, saka i 6 pa 20, uye B ane makadhi 2 anoti 7, 14, saka i 2 pa 20. Ma common multiples e 3 ne 7 anotanga ku 21, saka hapana kadhi rinowirirana mukati me 1 kusvika ku 20.
z-m-15-08.s.s3.model.1: A ane makadhi 5 ari ma multiples e 4, saka i 5/20, uye B ane makadhi 2 ari ma multiples e 7, saka i 2/20. Ndakanyora ma multiples ese e 4 ne 7 uye hapana kadhi rakafanana, saka hapana chiitiko apo vose vanokunda panguva imwechete.
z-m-15-08.s.s3.modelNote.1: I nzira inotarisa nekunyora marisiti zvakananga.

z-m-15-06.title: Forecast yakati 70% mukana wemvura, asi mvura haina kunaya
z-m-15-06.goal: Siyanisa mhedzisiro yezuva rimwe chete nemarekodhi emazuva mazhinji, chinja kutonga kwako nezvemukana nekuti une chokwadi chakadii nguva imwe neimwe data painokura, uye gadzira marekodhi aunoda kutonga.
z-m-15-06.material: Forecast yemamiriro ekunze yakati, 'Mangwana mukana wemvura ndi70%.' Pano, mukana we70% unoreva '70% yenzira pakati pekusanaya mvura zvachose (0%) nemvura inonaya zvechokwadi (100%).' Tinoda kufunga kuti forecast iyi inovimbika zvakadii tichishandisa marekodhi.
z-m-15-06.thinking.0: Kuchinja kutonga nechokwadi zvichienderana nehuwandu hwe data
z-m-15-06.thinking.1: Kusiyanisa mhedzisiro imwe chete nemarekodhi enguva dzakawanda
z-m-15-06.thinking.2: Kusarudza iwe pachako data inodiwa kutonga
z-m-15-06.prereq.0: Ruzivo rwekutaura mukana senhamba kubva ku0 kusvika ku100%
z-m-15-06.prereq.1: Hukama pakati pema percentages nema fractions (nhanho yegrade 6)
z-m-15-06.s.s1.prompt: Data inoratidzwa rimwe panguva. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza kuti unoongorora sei forecast iyi.
z-m-15-06.s.s1.hint.0: Padanho rimwe nerimwe, tsvaga iwe pachako huwandu hwemazuva ane mvura hwakaparadzaniswa nehuwandu hwose hwemazuva, uye uhuenzanise ne70%.
z-m-15-06.s.s1.hint.1: Kana marekodhi akura, rongedza kuti ndekupi kutonga kwako kwekutanga kwekuchengeta uye kupi kwekuchinja.
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.0.info: Zuva rakatevera forecast, mvura haina kunaya.
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unoongorora sei forecast kubva pamhedzisiro yezuva iri rimwe chete?
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.0.after: Mukana we70% unoreva kuti pane mukana we30% wekuti mvura inogona kusanaya. Kubva pamhedzisiro yezuva rimwe chete, zvakaoma kutonga kana forecast yaiva yakarurama kana yakashata.
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Forecast yakashata. Yakati 70% uye mvura haina kunaya, saka forecast haina kururama.
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakaverenga 70% se 'mvura inonaya zvechokwadi.' Mukana we30% ndiwo divi apo mvura isinganiye.
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Zvakaoma kutaura kuti yakashata kubva pamhedzisiro yezuva rimwe chete. Mukana wekuti mvura isanaye waiva 30% zvakare.
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kutonga uku hakusarudzi mukana kubva pamhedzisiro imwe chete, uye kunotarisawo mukana wasara.
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Forecast yakarurama. Pakanga pane mukana unosvika ku30% wekusanaya mvura, saka mhedzisiro inosangana neforecast.
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wakatonga kuti 'yakarurama' nekuti mhedzisiro yaiva kusanaya mvura. Kubva pamhedzisiro imwe chete, zvakaoma kunyange kuziva kana yaiva yakarurama.
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Kana mukana wemvura ndi70%, mvura inonaya zvechokwadi, saka kana isina kunaya, hofisi yeforecast yakanganisa.
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.1.info: Takaunganidza mazuva 10 apo mutaridzi wemamiriro ekunze mumwe chete akati 'mukana we70% wemvura.' Mvura yakanaya mazuva 7 uye haina kunaya mazuva 3.
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.1.ask: Uchitarisa rekodhi iyi, unoongorora sei forecasts dzemutaridzi uyu dze70%?
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.1.after: Mazuva 7 pakati pe10 rekodhi inosangana zvakanaka ne70%. Asi 10 huwandu hudiki hwemazuva, saka kana ukaunganidza zvakawanda, chokwadi chako chinogona kuva chakasimba. Rekodhi iyi chinongedzo chinovimbika zvakanyanya kupfuura mhedzisiro imwe chete.
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Rekodhi inosangana zvakanaka ne70%, asi mazuva 10 mashoma, saka tinofanira kuunganidza akawanda
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakatarisa zvose kuti rekodhi haipokani neforecast uye kuti huwandu hwe data hucharamba hushoma.
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Rekodhi haipokani neforecast, saka tinogona kuvimba ne70% yemutaridzi uyu
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakakwidza kuvimba kwako uchivimba nechokwadi chekuti rekodhi inosangana neforecast. Zvaizova zvakanakazve kungwarirawo huwandu, mazuva 10.
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Hazvina kunaya pamazuva 3, saka chirevo chemuoni wemamiriro ekunze uyu chaiva chisina kururama
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakaverenga zuva rimwe nerimwe risina mvura se 'chirevo chakaipa.' 70% zvinoreva zvakare kuti mvura inogona kusanaya pamazuva anenge 3.
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ne 70%, mvura inofanira kunaya pamazuva 10 ese kuti chirevo chive chakarurama
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.2.info: Takaunganidza mazuva 10 ekutanga apo mumwe muoni wemamiriro ekunze akati '70%,' uye mvura yakanaya pamazuva 2. Mushure mekuunganidza mamwe mazuva 40, paiva nemazuva 50 ese, uye mvura yakanaya pamazuva 16 ese.
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ungaongorora sei zvirevo zve 70% zvemuoni wemamiriro ekunze uyu?

Sezvo marekodhi anokura, tsananguro yekuti mhedzisiro yekutanga yaiva zvakangoitika inoshomeka, uye kutonga kwako kunochinjira kupfungwa yekuti 70% yemuoni uyu yakaoma kuvimba nayo sezvainoita.
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Mazuva 50 achiri mashoma uye i zvakangoitika, saka tinogona kuramba tichivimba nechirevo che 70%
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kunyangwe data yakakura kusvika mazuva 50, wakaedza kubata kuvimba kwako kwekutanga. Tarisa tsika inoratidzwa nedata hombe.
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Hapachina marekodhi anodiwa, uye tinogona kusarudza kuti zvirevo zvemuoni wemamiriro ekunze uyu zvatova zvisina kururama
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakaona kuti marekodhi emazuva 50 i chiratidzo chakajeka, asi wakavhara mukana wedata itsva inouya shure.
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Hatigone kuziva mamiriro ekunze ezuva rimwe nerimwe, saka marekodhi akaunganidzwa pamazuva akawanda haabatsiri
z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakarasa chiratidzo chinopiwa nemarekodhi emazuva akawanda. Kunyangwe usingagone kuziva zuva rimwe, unogona kutaura nezvetsika yemazuva akawanda.

z-m-15-06.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Kutonga uku kunowana ratio yemazuva ane mvura murekodhi uye kunoienzanisa nemukana wechirevo.
